moments.headline: Early strike gives Harbour Lights lead
moments.commentary: At 3', Ali Demir smashes it from 10.7 m at 117.9 km/h (xG 0.267) to make it 0-1, and Harbour Lights turn 59.5% possession and 2 shots into real control while Chao Phraya have 0 shots and more pressure to chase.

moments.headline: GOAL! Arthit Kaewmanee levels it 1-1
moments.commentary: At minute 15 his 8.2 m finish at 81.0 km/h makes it 1-1 and keeps Chao Phraya Rovers in the game. It matters because the Rovers have dominated this period with 100.0% possession and four shots on target, so momentum is clearly with them now.

moments.headline: Lead restored at 2-1
moments.commentary: At minute 39 Kittipong Saelim's 7.0 m finish (xG 0.197, shot 89.8 km/h) makes it 2-1 and puts Chao Phraya Rovers ahead. They've had 51.4% possession, 14 shots and xG 1.48, so this goal rewards their control and shifts momentum from Harbour Lights FC (xG 0.45).

moments.headline: Demir levels it at 2-2
moments.commentary: At 51', Ali Demir strikes from 8.0 m (58.3 km/h, xG 0.39) to make it 2-2; that equaliser halts Chao Phraya's momentum — between minutes 45 and 60 they had 22 pressures to Harbour Lights' 12, and the away side now regains control.

moments.headline: GOAL! Tawan Srisuk 3-2
moments.commentary: At 63', defender Tawan Srisuk fires in from 2.1 m with a 115.8 km/h strike (xG 0.551) to make it 3-2 for Chao Phraya Rovers. It rewards the home side's pressure this spell (home xG 0.55 vs away 0.0) and hands them momentum at a key stage.

moments.headline: Surasak fires Rovers 4-2
moments.commentary: At 69', Surasak's 16.4 m strike (107.9 km/h, xG 0.095) makes it 4-2 and shifts momentum to Chao Phraya Rovers — they've outshot Harbour Lights 25-10 and netted 2 goals in the 60–75 spell while piling up 24 pressures to 17, forcing the visitors to chase.

recap.headline: Wild Eight-Goal Thriller
recap.commentary: Chao Phraya Rovers edged a 5-3 win by turning slightly better control (50.6% possession) and far more pressure (193 pressures vs 175) into chances — 27 shots and 15 on target compared with 17 and 7. The game swung after Tawan Srisuk's 63rd-minute goal put them 3-2 and Arthit Kaewmanee's 87th-minute strike sealed it, turning pressure into late, decisive finishes.
